categories.main_business_segments: Wuxi Delinhai Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in lake and reservoir eutrophication endogenous governance, focusing on blue-green algae disaster emergency response and prevention, as well as whole-lake governance for water quality improvement. The company provides integrated blue-green algae governance technology equipment, professional operation and maintenance services, and biomass resource utilization. It also engages in biomass energy and zero-carbon technology sectors through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including integrated two-stage enhanced flotation, adjustable vortex well algae harvesting, blue-green algae cyst cluster disruption, pressurized algae control, and precision pollution sediment continuous governance technologies. It manufactures integrated equipment such as mobile algae-water separation devices, deep submersible high-pressure algae control equipment, and pollution sediment precision governance systems. The company emphasizes original innovation and has achieved international or domestic leading technology levels with multiple patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government departments, state-owned enterprises, and public institutions responsible for major lake governance in China, including regions like Taihu, Chaohu, Dianchi, and Erhai lakes. The company serves ecological protection and environmental governance sectors, providing services and equipment for blue-green algae control and lake eutrophication treatment. Its market includes 15 provinces and 27 cities, focusing on large and medium-sized lakes with eutrophication issues.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly across China, covering major lake regions such as Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Hubei, Yunnan, Guangdong, Inner Mongolia, and others. It has subsidiaries and projects in cities including Wuxi, Suzhou, Kunming, Dali, Yuxi, and Hefei. The company’s technology and services have been applied nationwide, including participation in national events like the G20 Hangzhou Summit and the 2023 Hangzhou Asian Games.
categories.supply_chain_position: Delinhai operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental governance supply chain. It develops and integrates advanced environmental technology equipment, provides installation, operation, and maintenance services, and engages in resource utilization of biomass byproducts. The company also invests in upstream biomass energy production through its subsidiaries, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider in lake eutrophication governance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes advancing lake ecological hospital models, expanding core equipment platforms, promoting methane emission reduction and CCER carbon asset development, and deepening zero-carbon and green hydrogen technology commercialization. R&D efforts emphasize innovation in algae control, sediment governance, digital lake health management, and green hydrogen electrolyzer technology. Collaboration with academic and research institutions supports forward-looking and customized technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of integrated environmental technology equipment, operation and maintenance service contracts, and resource utilization products such as biomass energy. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and carbon asset trading initiatives. Sales are primarily secured via public tenders and government procurement, with performance-based payment models increasingly adopted.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Delinhai is a leading enterprise in the blue-green algae governance and lake eutrophication endogenous treatment sector in China. It holds a dominant market position with recognized core technologies and extensive project experience. The company is acknowledged as an industry benchmark and has received multiple honors and government recognitions. Its comprehensive service model and innovative lake ecological hospital concept differentiate it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 310 million, a 30.92% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 13.44 million. Despite the decline, new orders increased by 22.42%, with a strong order backlog of about RMB 609 million. R&D investment rose to 9.46% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented innovation strategy. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.68 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.43 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Delinhai offers unique value through its integrated, scalable, and low-energy consumption blue-green algae control technologies and comprehensive lake governance solutions. Its proprietary equipment platforms and the innovative lake ecological hospital model provide one-stop monitoring, diagnosis, treatment, and management services. The company’s focus on environmental performance-based payment models and carbon asset development further differentiates its offerings, emphasizing sustainable and results-driven ecological restoration.
